title: Exotic Sri Lanka | Couple Special
highlights: Observe elephant care at Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and enjoy a cultural evening in Kandy with the Kandyan Dance.
Explore Kandy's highlights including the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic and Royal Botanical Gardens.
Experience Nuwara Eliya's charm with visits to Hanuman Temple, Ramboda Falls, and Hakgala Botanical Gardens.
Visit Mirrissa Beach and enjoy complimentary water rides including banana boat rides and tube rides.
overview:
About the Tour:
An aura full of charismatic charm, ethereal beaches, a playful parade of elephants, historical places, incredible train rides, lush tea estates, and mesmerizing landscapes, Sri Lanka is a country that is on the bucket list of all travelers. From surfing at the thrilling waves, and relaxing at the pristine beaches to taking scenic train trails and getting playful with the elephants, Sri Lanka is definitely a real jewel!
Embark on this exotic vacation by visiting the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and watch the naughty elephants, yet adorable creatures bathe in the river near the orphanage where they engage in mischief, pull each other by their tails, and try to escape the hands of their caretakers in amusing ways on your way to Kandy. Peek into some of the tea estates and welcome the fresh aroma of the tea and herbs in the rolling green hills offering breathtaking views in Nuwara Eliya. Absorb the laid-back culture of Mirissa - a sunny beach town offering great waves for surfing, and waters teeming with marine life, from turtles to big blue whales. Spend the day enjoying the crystal blue water, snorkeling among incredible marine life (make sure to keep your eyes peeled for turtles!), and enjoying every moment of this slice of heaven. Capture a glimpse of the sky changing its colors and allowing you spectacular views over the ocean through the many leaning palm trees.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Transfer to Kandy | Enroute Visit to Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage | Kandyan Dance Show
days.desc: Welcome to Sri Lanka! Upon arriving in Colombo, get driven to Kandy. Enroute make a stop at Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, where you can see various elephants that are injured & abandoned. Continue the journey to Kandy & upon arrival, check in at the hotel. Later, enjoy a drive to Kandy Lake followed by a Kandyan Dance Show. Admire views of the beautiful lake & then enjoy Kandyan Dance Show, highlighting Sri Lanka's heritage with engaging performances. Afterwards, get driven back to the hotel.

items.title: Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show

days.title: Kandy Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, enjoy the Kandy sightseeing tour. Begin with a visit to Market Crafts Centre, where you can purchase handmade items & souvenirs. Next, visit the Gem Museum, featuring a collection of semi-precious stones. Stroll through royal botanical gardens, showcasing diverse flora & fauna & Spice Garden, where you can immerse yourself in Sri Lankan spices. Don't miss visiting Orchid House, offering a display of orchids of different shades & Kandy Temple, housing the tooth relic of Lord Buddha.

items.title: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic

days.title: Transfer to Nuwara Eliya | Nuwara Eliya Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Check out & get driven to Nuwara Eliya. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel. Later, enjoy Nuwara Eliya city tour. Visit Seetha Eliya, a temple related to legendary Ramayan. Then, visit Haggala Gardens, one of Sri Lanka's largest botanical gardens. Also, explore Victoria Park, featuring vibrant blooms & Gregory Lake, where you can try boating. Don't miss visiting Ramboda Falls, surrounded by lush greenery & Hanuman Temple, known for its spiritual importance. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

items.title: Check-in at Deluxe Hotel
items.hotel: Oak-Ray Summer Hill Breeze Hotel, Nuwara Eliya

items.title: Full Day Nuwara Eliya Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis

days.title: Transfer to Bentota | Enroute Visit to Edinburgh Viewpoint & Kithulgala | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Today, check out & get driven to Bentota. Enroute, stop at Edinburg Viewpoint, offering views of mist-covered hills. Then get driven to Kithulgala, where you try rafting at Kelani River (at extra cost). Continue to Bentota & upon arrival, check in at the hotel. Later, you can spend day at leisure. You can visit Cinnamon Island, known for its cinnamon cultivation process, or Brief Garden, featuring sculptures designed by Bevis Bawa. Later, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Trip to Edinburgh Viewpoint, Sri Lanka

days.title: Visit to Madu River & Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery
days.desc: In the morning, get ready for the Bentota sightseeing tour. Begin with a visit to the Madu River, where you can enjoy a boat safari (at extra cost). Admire the beauty of the surrounding mangrove forests & wetlands, with opportunities to spot wildlife. After that, get driven to Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery, where you can witness endangered sea turtles & their hatchlings being released into the sea. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Excursion to Mirissa & Galle
days.desc: Get ready for an excursion to Mirrisa & Galle. Begin with a Dutch Reformed Church, featuring colonial architecture. Next, explore Dutch Fort & Fort Lighthouse, the two most striking constructions offering a glimpse into Sri Lanka's colonial past. Don't miss visiting Maritime Museum, where exhibits showcase shipwrecks & Meera Mosque, reflecting town's cultural heritage, before you get driven to Mirrisa Beach & stroll around the coastline & capture views of the shores from Coconut Tree Hill.

days.title: Transfer to Colombo | Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Post check-out, get driven to Colombo. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel. Later, get driven for city tour. Visit Galle Face Green, a stunning oceanfront park. Next, explore Gangaramaya Temple, known for its religious artefacts. Wander through Colombo Fort, featuring colonial-era buildings & Lotus Tower, the tallest structure in Sri Lanka. Don't miss walking at Suspension Bridge, providing views of Colombo's waterways & Floating Market, offering a glimpse into Colombo's market culture.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Reflect on the amazing memories you've spent in Sri Lanka. Later, check out from the hotel & get driven to the airport to board your flight back home. This is where your trip comes to an end.
